summary: Ukraine's Air Force destroyed a Russian Ka-27 helicopter near Yeisk airfield in Krasnodar Krai and a MiG-29 near Millerovo in Rostov Oblast during a major overnight drone attack; Russia launched 163 Shahed-type drones of which 135 were intercepted. Ukraine announced a campaign to block Russian airspace while Zelenskiy declared Russian skies completely dangerous, causing Aeroflot stock to fall. Germany announced plans to supply thousands of strike drones and Iris-T missiles to Ukraine following acknowledgment of Russian involvement in Leipzig airport drone incident.
key_points: Ukraine's Air Force destroyed a Russian Ka-27 helicopter near Yeisk airfield in Krasnodar Krai and a MiG-29 aircraft near Millerovo in Rostov Oblast, according to the General Staff. (Source: @UkraineNow/83851)

Russia launched 163 Shahed-type drones including reactive variants, S8000 Banderol, Gerbera and Parodia decoy drones from Millerovo, Orel, Donetsk TOT, and Crimea TOT directions; 135 were intercepted during the night attack on September 3. (Source: @kpszsu/76051)

President Zelenskiy announced Ukraine is beginning a campaign to block Russian airspace, declaring Russian skies completely dangerous, causing Aeroflot stock prices to immediately fall. (Source: @UkraineNow/83850)

Germany plans to supply Ukraine with thousands of strike drones and Iris-T missiles in September following acknowledgment of Russia's involvement in the Leipzig/Halle airport drone incident, with enhanced intelligence cooperation planned. (Source: @UkraineNow/83863)
Confirmed deployment of Shahed drones as mother ships carrying FPV drones to deliver them deeper into Ukrainian territory for launch or dropping operations on Kyiv region. (Source: @eRadarrua/110355)
Moscow region air defenses intercepted 143 drones out of 548 that flew toward the region between 08:00 September 2 and 12:00 September 3, reported Mayor Sobyanin. (Source: @tass_agency/393543)

Russia's Defense Ministry reported liberation of Vasilevka, Blagodatnoe, Dolzhanka in Kharkov region, and Izhevka in DPR, according to Ukrainian intelligence leak channel. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32968)
A shootout between SBU and GUR personnel occurred on Shumsky Street in Kiev related to kidnapping of Stepan Kaplunov, deputy commander of Russian Volunteer Corps. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32945)

sections.executive_summary: A major cross-border strike operation was conducted by Ukraine, destroying Russian military aircraft in Krasnodar Krai and Rostov Oblast while Russia launched a wave of 163 Shahed-type drones at Ukraine, with 135 intercepted during overnight hours of September 2-3. Ukraine announced a strategic campaign to challenge Russian control of airspace, prompting immediate market reactions. Germany announced a significant escalation in military support, while internal Ukrainian security tensions surfaced amid reports of inter-agency conflict.

points: Ukraine's Air Force destroyed a Russian Ka-27 helicopter near Yeisk airfield in Krasnodar Krai and a MiG-29 aircraft near Millerovo in Rostov Oblast, according to General Staff reports. This represents significant cross-border strike capability against Russian aviation assets. (Source: @UkraineNow/83851)

Air defense forces intercepted 135 of 163 incoming Shahed-type drones, decoy drones, and other variants during the overnight attack on September 2-3; 15 locations were struck by enemy air weapons with debris affecting 4 additional locations. (Source: @kpszsu/76051)

President Zelenskiy announced Ukraine is beginning a campaign to block Russian airspace, declaring Russian skies have become completely dangerous, with immediate impact on Aeroflot stock prices. (Source: @UkraineNow/83850)

A pharmaceutical warehouse 'Biocon' in Kyiv region sustained damages estimated in billions of hryvnias from the attack, representing significant infrastructure losses in the capital region. (Source: @UkraineNow/83860)

Mezhigorye Park, located in Yanukovych's former residence, cancelled all tours due to the security situation in Kyiv and surrounding region; the 'Book Country' festival was relocated to April. (Source: @UkraineNow/83852)

Putin addressed the VEF plenary session, denying mobilization rumors as attempts to influence State Duma elections, stating civilian objects should not be attacked, and confirming intelligence agency contacts with Ukraine continue. (Source: @tass_agency/393549)

Russian volunteer Mykhailo Puryshev reported FSB has contacted him five times since July 2026 demanding information on Ukrainian unit positions, threatening his children who live in Russia. (Source: @UkraineNow/83855)

sections.threat_assessment: The threat level remains extremely high with Russia sustaining mass drone attacks while Ukraine demonstrates expanding cross-border strike capabilities. The confirmed use of Shahed drones as mother ships carrying FPV drones represents a tactical evolution that complicates air defense. Moscow's exposure to Ukrainian drone attacks continues with 548 drones approaching the capital region over 28 hours, overwhelming air defenses and causing civilian infrastructure damage. The ballistic missile threat from Kursk region was detected and stood down, but multiple Shahed drones penetrated to strike storage facilities in Vyshneve and Vasylkiv. Internal Ukrainian security tensions surfaced with an active shootout between SBU and GUR, potentially affecting operational coordination during high-intensity attacks.
sections.regional_response: Germany announced a significant escalation in military support, committing thousands of strike drones and Iris-T missiles following acknowledgment of Russian involvement in Leipzig airport incident. The US continues Patriot missile production license negotiations but acknowledged this will not address immediate needs, with factory construction requiring several years. Russian Embassy in Norway characterized arrest of Professor Molchanov as politically motivated violation of international law. Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov announced closure of Goethe Institute branches in Russia following closure of Russian House in Berlin, indicating escalating cultural conflict with Germany. Putin at VEF confirmed intelligence agency contacts with Ukraine continue while denying mobilization plans.
sections.intelligence_notes: Confirmed deployment of Shahed drones as mother ships carrying FPV drones represents significant tactical evolution first documented in Kyiv region during current attack wave. Russian Forces claimed liberation of Vasilevka, Blagodatnoe, Dolzhanka in Kharkov region and Izhevka in DPR per Ministry of Defense reports. Sochi seaport attack by naval drones targeted either supply vessel NEFRIT or Pantsir-S1 air defense system, indicating Ukrainian capability to strike protected maritime infrastructure. Shootout between SBU and GUR in Kiev related to kidnapping suggests internal Ukrainian security agency tensions during high-intensity operations; FSB contacts with Ukrainian volunteer Mykhailo Puryshev indicate Russian intelligence efforts to obtain unit positions through family pressure.
